blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven latest renders after the four-panel pelvis-blend transition: sit and crouch still expose gray avatar surfaces through/around the shorts; crouch retains a triangular inner-thigh coverage opening. The placement hypothesis did not solve coverage. Redesign connected seat/gusset and thigh wrap; no fit acceptance.

Current front/side/rear and sit/crouch renders show weak pleat definition, angular hem edges, and broad folded sheets behind and between the legs in seated/flexed poses. Redraft sewn panel contour and cloth response; no appearance acceptance.

Current arms-up and arm-cross renders still show dense faceting/wrinkles at sleeve caps, sleeves and underarm transitions; the collar remains a tall exposed ring. Correct panel joins and surface flow before appearance acceptance.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
